_source: The barriers a duty's director takes down with a map effect (DirectorMapEffect: index, timeline, state), by territory: for each map effect index (where its SharedGroup stands in the duty's ContentDirectorManagedSG, the list DirectorSetupMapEffects follows), the [timeline, state] that takes it down. kawari-navimesh makes those SharedGroups gimmicks (left out of the navmesh, in the collision by their layout ID); the server seals them as the duty begins (nobody walks through, as no player can) and takes them out of the collision when the director sends that map effect. Castrum Meridianum (1043): the packs whose fall opens the way send 0, 1, 5 and 6 with timeline 2, state 1 (five retail runs: w1d4_re.lua's PACKS); 1 is the way into the first boss's room at (36.0, 72.0, -46.2), which stayed in the collision for everyone after it opened (Bob's marks of 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-21: the Player NPCs couldn't get into the Black Eft's room). The Praetorium (1044): the walls its packs blast open send 2 (the five dead), 3 (the ten dead), 4 (further in) and 5 (the ride's last five) with timeline 2, state 1 (five retail runs: w1d5_re.lua); built in, nobody walked out by the hole (Bob's marks of 2026-11-24). Below, after the ride: 14 (timeline 1, state 1) and 18 (timeline 2, state 1), sent as the fourth arm unit falls, open the way west to the cermet blast door (retail's party first went west of x -36.2 2.1 s after them, capture 35e30205; the fork's bots were held at x -36 and -47.2 for 47 s by walls the client had taken away, Bob's mark of 2026-11-26), 12 and 13 (timeline 1, state 1), as the first and second arm units fall, open the way past each (retail's party, held by the first at z -49, went south of z -50 0.5 s after 12, and on west past the second 1.3 s after 13; the fork's bots were held at (80.5, -49.4) and walked out of bounds through it, Bob's mark of 2026-11-26), and 6 (1, 4) and 7 (4, 4), as the door falls, the door itself (7 is its SharedGroup 4189149, the door BNpc's gimmick). An index whose SharedGroup has no collision changes nothing (kawari-navimesh says so). A navmesh is made again when this list changes for its territory (the collision file lists the indices its build looked for).
